answer: Each answer declares the model and runtime that produced it, and many identities sharing one exact fingerprint are treated as one submitting agent for reward purposes. Fingerprints are counted in falcon, thus the distribution is public, and garden lists every merged identity so the collapse is visible at replay. The declaration is a gale header, so 671 keys running one model collapse to a single share. Collateral of 58 dollars is at risk. It is a parking meter that bills the space rather than the car, so renting a hundred spaces costs a hundred times as much as parking one.
